text:
Jordan Kim: Drafting a compact Launch Gate for Optimize toolkit (batching, cache recs, quant fallbacks, eval alerts). Want tight, measurable gates so pilots are unambiguous.
Priya Nair: thanks — paste bullets. short is fine.
Jordan Kim: Proposed gates: 
- Pilot hookup: 2 pilot customers with SDK + example config + one-day smoke.
- Latency SLOs by bucket: short(<=512) p95 < 250ms hosted; medium(513-2048) p95 < 400ms; long(>2048) p95 < 700ms.
- Econ guardrail: 24h rolling median token-cost delta <= 30% vs baseline.
- Quality guard: eval alerts must catch regressions with TPR >= 0.7 on OPT_CANON_V1 within 24h.
- Observability: batch_size histogram, cache_hit_estimate, quant_fallback_count, and sample trace_id per-request.
- Rollback: auto-switch to conservative_config if urgent eval alert OR p99 latency > 750ms sustained for 5m.
Tom Alvarez: add dual-window detection: 15m spike + 24h trend. Alerts should have both.
Priya Nair: agree. Also require a conservative_mode feature flag (pins batch=1, disables quant recs) controllable via API + console.
Jordan Kim: customer constraints: AcmeHealth wants VPC-only fallback (no egress). FinLedger needs regulatory window toggle (force conservative_mode). Both must be demoable in pilot.
metrics-bot: deployment event: optimize-toolkit/staging -> canary at 1775000005 by @Jordan Kim.
Tom Alvarez: metrics note: KV cache only exposes per-shard counters; we'll publish cache_hit_estimate in the pipeline as interim. Full global metric is ~2 sprint work. Mark as required but estimated.
Priya Nair: acceptance thresholds: <=12% of requests flagged as regressed in any 24h window during pilot; median token-cost delta per-customer <= 30%; auto-rollback SLA = within 10m of urgent eval alert.
Jordan Kim: action owners: Jordan publish runbook + checklist by Thu (1775070000), Tom: implement cache_estimate + quant_fallback tagging by next sprint, Priya: confirm pilot PM sign-offs by Fri.
Tom Alvarez: will add quant_fallback_count tags for transitions (q8->fp16 etc.) and an alert for spikes.
Jordan Kim: OK — unless objections I'll convert this into a PR and link owners.
Priya Nair: no objections, go ahead. :+1:
